key_moments: J. Fajardo (Panama) received a yellow card for serious foul play in the 53rd minute.
Jude Bellingham broke the deadlock in the 62nd minute, converting from Bukayo Saka's corner.
Harry Kane doubled England's lead in the 67th minute with a header from Jude Bellingham's cross, becoming England's all-time leading World Cup scorer with 11 goals.
A. Andrade (Panama) received a yellow card for serious foul play in the 84th minute.
Panama's Jose Fajardo had a late goal disallowed for offside in the 91st minute.

standout_performers.reason: Scored the crucial opening goal and assisted the second, inspiring England's second-half performance.

matches.tactical_summary: England dominated possession but struggled to penetrate Panama's deep-lying 5-4-1 defense in a goalless first half. The Three Lions found their breakthrough in the second half through a set-piece and a quick follow-up goal, which effectively sealed their victory.

narrative: England secured their spot atop Group L with a decisive 2-0 victory over Panama, overcoming a resilient defensive effort from the Central American side. Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane delivered the crucial second-half goals, ensuring England's progression to the Round of 16.
next_round_notes: England's Jarell Quansah was substituted in the 63rd minute after twisting his right ankle, raising concerns for his availability in the next round. Quansah also received a yellow card in the 60th minute.
